english.logic.122.message.001: "Hey bud, what's with the helmet indoors?" asks the curious guard.
english.logic.122.message.002: Just as you begin to speak, the Sarien guard says, "How many Analexians does it take to seduce a three-eared female sillovite."
english.logic.122.message.003: "Which way to the little boys room?" you ask, hoping Sariens even do that sort of thing.
english.logic.122.message.004: "Is this the way to the Star Generator?" you ask.
english.logic.122.message.005: "Have you played King's Quest III?" you ask the Guard.
english.logic.122.message.006: "Are we having fun yet?" you ask the guard.
english.logic.122.message.011: "Ssshh!" you exclaim, "I'm hiding from the boss." figuring you might confuse the guard.
english.logic.122.message.012: After a reasonable period of silence at your end, the Guard answers his own joke, "Two!!!". He does not seem unduly impressed by your lack of laughter.
english.logic.122.message.013: The puzzled expression on the face of your new found friend confirms your worst fears.
english.logic.122.message.014: "Don't ask me, I just work here," responds the unhelpful guard.
english.logic.122.message.015: "Yes" responds the surprised Guard, "I just bought it last week. It was on sale for 128,000 buckazoids at Tiny's Holodisk Shop. What a bargain!!!"
english.logic.122.message.016: "This is the most fun I've had since the Hipoglopus ate my brother," responds the bored looking Sarien.
english.logic.122.message.020: The guard pretends not to notice you.
english.logic.122.message.021: Quiet! You don't want to accidentally blow your cover, do you?
english.logic.122.message.022: Shouldn't you be trying to save your planet?
english.logic.122.message.023: Talk, talk, talk, can't you find anything better to do?
english.logic.122.message.024: The guard wrinkles his nose in disgust. "Leave me alone!" he exclaims. "You smell like the ventricular portion of a Hypoglopus!" Obviously, this guard has no taste at all.
english.logic.122.message.025: The guard looks at you as though you just questioned his mothers heritage. Perhaps you should not waste time conversing with the guards.
english.logic.122.message.027: The guard describes to you in graphic detail his previous evening's exploits.
english.logic.122.message.028: The guard outlines his favorite massacre, "The Great Daventry Rout" as he called it. You ponder the meaning of this for a while.
english.logic.122.message.029: The guard looks at you as though you look different somehow.
english.logic.122.message.030: Leave me alone. I am guarding the Star Generator.
english.logic.122.message.032: As you pucker up your lips and lean close, you suddenly remember what your mother taught you about Sariens. In a rare moment of wisdom, you decide not to get anything started you're  unwilling to finish.
english.logic.122.message.033: He looks to be armed and dangerous. I wouldn't mess around with him.
english.logic.122.message.035: "Do you own King's Quest II?" asks the nosy guard.
english.logic.122.message.037: "Great!!!" responds the guard. Pondering his interest you ask yourself whether or not this guy is getting a kickback from Sierra On-Line. Later you realize this is silly, what would a Sarien do with money from Coarsegold?
english.logic.122.message.038: Everyone gets their kicks in different ways. Yours is the strangest of which I am aware.

english.view.186.description: This is your survival kit. It formerly contained a Xenon Army Knife and a can of dehydrated water.
english.view.199.description: Written on the electronic gadget are the words DIALECT TRANSLATOR. On one end is a dial and a light (currently on).
english.view.215.description: This is a data storage cartridge. On it are the words ASTRAL BODY FORMATION: THE UNTOLD STORY.
english.view.217.description: Written on the electronic gadget are the words DIALECT TRANSLATOR. On one end is a dial and a light (currently dim).
english.view.218.description: The Orat part seems to consist of a spiny piece of bone with a small amount of somewhat less solid material clinging to one end.
english.view.219.description: The keycard is a flat rectangular piece of synthetic material which is magnetically keyed for passing check stations. Written in tiny letters are the words ``Beek and Hinder Security Systems''.
english.view.220.description: This is a piece of highly reflective view shield glass from the escape pod. Due to its special design there are no sharp edges.
english.view.221.description: This is the power key to the sand skimmer.
english.view.222.description: This is a vessel of that acrid-yet-buoyant Keronian Ale.
english.view.224.description: The buckazoid is a flat piece of a precious alien metal. You have %v124 of them.
english.view.225.description: This is your survival kit. It contains a Xenon Army Knife and a can of dehydrated water.
english.view.226.description: This is a cylinder of dehydrated water. At the top of the cylinder is a regulator and a short nozzle. On the side is a label.
english.view.227.description: This is a Sarien ID card. The name on the card is Butston Freem. You wonder if this is a common Sarien name.
english.view.228.description: This small item is a Pulseray. It delivers concentrated pulses of energy in the direction it is pointed.
english.view.229.description: The smoke bomb appears to be of the impact detonation variety. You don't want to be to close to this thing when it discharges.
english.view.230.description: This is a small remote control unit. On it is a button. You wonder what it controls remotely.
english.view.232.description: It is a plant you are not familiar with.
